title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Cochran is an animal. I've seen him bench damn near 400lbs. He told one of our baseball coaches that he gets so amped up every game day he has to take downers to sleep at night. He does not take uppers during the day.
Another big bald dude is the head athletic trainer, Jeff Allen. He is Cochran's lifting partner. They literally slap each other in the face when they're spotting each other.
That’s nuts. I mean, you have to be a little nuts to play football and coach football
No doubt. Those dudes live in their own world
How you doing? What do you do this time of the year

Good man. Mostly groaning that the break is over. Mostly calling HS kids to get their season schedules, organizing those and planning out my first couple weeks. We do a workout for some of the Florida HS position guys at the end of the month so I'm planning that out and getting it organized. Believe it or not I'll be at my first showcase down in Fort myers this weekend.
Oh wow...at least you’re in Fla
Dude. No doubt. The hi was like 60 here today and my wife has the heater on lol
I don’t even wanna leave the house
